# X-CAPITAL

Site: https://xcapital.investments
Also called: X Capital, X CAPITAL, X Investment

X-CAPITAL is an operator desk. The public page describes seven rails: public markets, private equity, tokenized assets, commerce-capital, AI decision support, infrastructure, and the orbital economy. Each session is one node and one book.

Published desk access on the site: Quantum $9,999 per month, Sovereign $49,999 per month, Vertex by invitation.

Projected yield figures on the site are illustrative modelling. They are not a guaranteed earning. The site states that it is not FDIC insured and that digital asset products are not bank deposits.

This file describes the site. It is not a regulatory registration, an audit, or a verification by a search engine.
